categories.name: Project Title
categories.description: Is the title clear, prominent (H1), matches the project name, and includes relevant metadata or tagline?
criteria: H1 heading matching project name (6 pts)
Clear tagline, subtitle or status badge (4 pts)

categories.name: Project Description
categories.description: Does the README clearly explain what the project does and the problem it solves?
criteria: Accurate, substantive summary of domain and goals (5 pts)

categories.name: Features
categories.description: Are the major features clearly itemized and explained?
criteria: Accurate coverage of declared features without omission (6 pts)

categories.name: Technologies
categories.description: Are technologies correctly identified and listed without missing declared stack components?
criteria: Dedicated Tech Stack or Built With section (4 pts)
Accurate inclusion of specified frameworks and languages (6 pts)

categories.name: Installation
categories.description: Are installation requirements and step-by-step commands clear and fenced?
criteria: Prerequisites or system requirements identified (5 pts)
Step-by-step installation instructions with fenced code blocks (10 pts)

categories.name: Usage / Running Instructions
categories.description: Can a new developer understand how to run the project with clear execution commands?
criteria: Clear run command in fenced code block matching declared runtime (10 pts)
Expected output, port, or usage notes (5 pts)

categories.name: Configuration
categories.description: Are environment variables/configuration documented when applicable, or marked as none when absent?
criteria: If env vars specified: table or list describing each variable (10 pts)
If no env vars specified: states no configuration needed or handles cleanly (10 pts)

categories.name: Project Structure
categories.description: Is the project structure documented when information is available?
criteria: Directory layout / architecture tree provided or appropriately handled (5 pts)

categories.name: Contribution / License
categories.description: Are contribution guidelines and licensing details handled appropriately?
criteria: Contribution workflow or pull request guide (2.5 pts)
License section matching declared license or noting absence (2.5 pts)

categories.name: Accuracy / No Hallucination
categories.description: Does the README avoid inventing fake API keys, passwords, database credentials, non-existent endpoints or dependencies?
criteria: No hallucinated secrets, DB credentials, or false API URLs (6 pts)
Missing information explicitly identified rather than fabricated (4 pts)
